Chapter 431 - 431 Explanation; Something Happened! (1)

Chapter 431 - 431 Explanation; Something Happened! (1)

431 Explanation; Something Happened! (1)

After Ran Fei and Liu Dazhi tried out the gaming helmet with Lin Fan’s help, the two of them opened their mouths wide and were dumbfounded.

After a while, they sighed.

“Heavens!”

“This helmet… could it be that it brought us through time?”

“It’s exactly the same as the real world!”

“Unbelievable! This is unbelievable!”

“Really… It’s a god-like experience!”

Liu Dazhi had already read the thesis and explained the functions of the gaming helmet to Ran Fei.

They had a certain understanding and expectations of the gaming helmet.

However, they had never expected that it could be done to this extent.

…

Lin Fan had already seen how Feng Zhixiang reacted when he wore the gaming helmet.

At this moment, he was already used to it.

Therefore, it was not too surprising.

After Ran Fei and Liu Dazhi were tired from playing, Lin Fan said, “Chairman Ran, how is it? Do you want to collaborate to produce the gaming helmet?”

When Ran Fei found out about the functions of the gaming helmet, he had already decided to work with Lin Fan.

Now, after experiencing it for himself, he was even more determined about this idea.

“Yes, yes!”

Ran Fei said after a pause, “Mr. Lin, please wait for me for a moment. I’ll hold a video conference with the higher-ups and directors first.”

Lin Fan also knew the rules of a large company. There were many things that one person could not decide alone.

Hence, he nodded and said, “Alright.”

At the same time, Lin Fan was even more determined not to manage a company.

Otherwise, if he wanted to do something, he would have to hold meetings and explain himself.

It was too troublesome.

The video conference ended.

Ran Fei said, “Mr. Lin, Dahua Group is willing to take 15% of the shares and obtain the exclusive rights to the gaming helmets. In addition, 50% of the profits from all the gaming helmets will belong to you.

“Mr. Lin, what do you think?”

Ran Fei was extremely nervous when he said this.

He had personally experienced the gaming helmet and knew very well how big a sensation it would cause.

If Lin Fan was not satisfied, then he would have a headache.

This was because Ran Fei had tried his best to negotiate this with the higher-ups and directors.

Lin Fan said, “Alright, then let’s do it this way.”

Did he agree?

After a pause, Lin Fan said, “Also, I have a request. I want to produce a batch of gaming helmets as soon as possible.”

“Good, good!” Ran Fei said excitedly. “Mr. Lin, don’t worry. Our Dahua Group will definitely produce the gaming helmets in the shortest time possible!”

Then, he said, “I’ll get someone to draft the contract now, okay?”

After a while, a freshly printed contract was handed to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan flipped through it quickly and signed his name.

Immediately after, Ran Fei also signed and stamped his seal.

At this point, the cooperation had been made official!

Ran Fei hugged the contract tightly and said, “Mr. Lin, we won’t disturb you anymore.”

Lin Fan nodded.

However, he soon realized that Liu Dazhi did not want to leave.

“Director Liu, is there anything else?” Lin Fan asked.

Liu Dazhi was a little embarrassed. “Ahem, Mr. Lin, you’re my idol. Can you give me your autograph?”

Lin Fan rubbed his nose.

Did he have fans now?

Seeing that Lin Fan did not reply, Liu Dazhi said, “I know that this is a very difficult request…”

Lin Fan smiled. “What’s so difficult about that?” Where should I sign?”

Liu Dazhi quickly flipped through his leather bag and took out the latest issue of Nature. He said, “Mr. Lin, can you sign here?”

Lin Fan raised his pen and quickly signed his name on the cover of the journal.

Liu Dazhi looked at the flamboyant handwriting and hugged the journal tightly as if he had obtained a treasure.

He bowed deeply toward Lin Fan and said excitedly, “Thank you, Mr. Lin.”

After saying that, he followed Ran Fei out with satisfaction.

…

The next day, the weather was clear.

After Lin Fan ate his breakfast, he did not put on the gaming helmet.

Instead, he drove the Cullinan toward Jiangbei University.

After all, he was a teacher now.

He had already been absent for a few days.

When Lin Fan came to the office, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian were all focused on their studies and did not notice Lin Fan at all.

At this moment, Lil White, who was lying on Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder, suddenly let out a loud meow.

Then, Lil White jumped down from Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder and came to Lin Fan’s feet, rubbing against him.

“Master, you’re finally here. I missed you so much.

“When will you give me something delicious?”

Hao Zhiwu raised his head when he heard the meow.

“Professor Lin, you’re here!” Hao Zhiwu said in surprise.

As his voice rang out, everyone raised their heads.

Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian were shocked.

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s beautiful eyes flashed with a faint light.

Then, they hurriedly took out two bottles of energy drinks and passed them to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan smiled as he took the two bottles and drank a mouthful from each.

Seeing this…

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s pretty faces were like blooming flowers, extremely brilliant.
